scope: A vertical splitter in an area-owned form: role, orientation, label, position and range; increment, decrement, written positions and 4D's own limit, with the attached pane resizing; VoiceOver reading and adjustment

environment.compiler: 4D Server 20.8 Compile project, arm64_macOS_lib and x86_64_generic

pixels: Each AX run compares the form, before any adjustment, with the same window built without plugin, component or helpers: zero changed pixels below the title bar.

its value is its position within the window's width
it can be stepped or moved to a position
the form is pixel-identical to the plugin-free form
an increment moves the splitter one step and widens the pane by the same amount
a decrement moves it back
writing a position moves the splitter there through 4D's splitter handling
writing the current position changes nothing
a position past its limit stops where 4D's own limit holds it

rejectedApproach: Native posted drags. A physical drag moves the splitter and runs On Clicked at each step, but 4D's tracker follows the physical pointer and posted mouse events left it unmoved.
knownDifferences: An accessibility adjustment does not run the splitter's On Clicked
VoiceOver introduces the splitter as collapsed on left, because 4D's panes are not grouped as a split view
